backend/main.mo: Actor defines service categories, subcategory mappings, and includes authorization and blob-storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing bilingual UI features, related files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing multiple frontend files, components, and configs.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base layer defining design tokens, OKLCH color variables, and light/dark theme CSS custom properties.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting root div and loading main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app with TanStack Router, React Query setup, layout wrapper, and route definitions for core pages.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminGuard: Component gating admin pages using Internet Identity login and admin-role checks with fallback UI states.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminJobPo: Admin UI listing pending/all job posts with approve/reject actions and loading/empty states.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminWorke: Admin interface to review, approve, reject, verify, and feature workers with loading states and toggles.
frontend/src/components/common/SafeIconI: Image component that safely loads icons and falls back to a default image on error or invalid src.
frontend/src/components/i18n/BilingualTe: Renders English and regional text stacked with customizable styling.
frontend/src/components/i18n/I18nProvide: Provides state-based language selection, translation lookup, and context for multilingual UI.
frontend/src/components/jobs/JobBoard.ts: Displays approved job postings with bilingual titles, job details, and call buttons.
frontend/src/components/landing/FooterBa: Footer displaying app name, community messages, WhatsApp contact, and attribution with bilingual text.
frontend/src/components/landing/HeaderBa: Responsive header with state selector, navigation links, and mobile menu toggle using i18n.
frontend/src/components/workers/WorkerCa: Renders a worker profile card with safe field access, photo handling, translated labels, and contact actions.
Defines worker category groups and subcategories with icons, plus utilities for accessing all subcategory labels.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the current Internet Identity and invalidates queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminMutations.ts: Provides admin mutations for approving, rejecting, verifying, and featuring workers and jobs, with query invalidation and error logging.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity provider handling login, identity persistence, and auth client setup for the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of data‑fetching hooks that query jobs, workers, admin status, and user profiles from the backend actor with error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollToSection.ts: Empty hook file with no implementation.
frontend/src/hooks/useWorkerSearch.ts: Provides a React Query hook to fetch workers filtered by area, category, or subcategory, with input sanitization and worker data validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useWorkerTaxonomy.ts: Fetches worker categories and subcategories with fallbacks and defensive validation, returning a safe taxonomy structure.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and theme variables for colors, typography, and global layout.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app, setting up React Query and the Internet Identity provider before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Renders the admin panel with tabs for reviewing worker registrations and job posts, protected by an admin guard.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Implements the landing page with search, category navigation, bilingual text, and worker discovery UI.
frontend/src/pages/JobRequestPage.tsx: Provides a form for users to submit job requests, including validation, submission to backend, and success handling.
frontend/src/pages/WorkerRegistrationPag: Implements worker registration with form inputs, photo upload, validation, and backend submission.
frontend/src/pages/WorkerSearchResultsPa: Search results page that normalizes taxonomy-based filters, syncs them with URL params, and fetches matching workers.
frontend/src/utils/bilingualTaxonomy.ts: Maps categories and subcategories to i18n keys and returns bilingual labels with fallbacks.
frontend/src/utils/errors.ts: Provides safe extraction and logging of error messages from unknown error values.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters with sessionStorage support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind config extending colors, layouts, animations, and plugins for the UI theme.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing platform goals, architecture, known issues, and existing features.
